comparison.objective: Seat a Mini-ITX motherboard on four locating pins with rear I/O aligned; candidate separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rigid-board alignment and simultaneous multi-pin insertion versus pouring, screen load sharing and bridge-clearing agitation.
comparison.success_condition: All holes seated on pins, I/O aligned, board still and grippers ≥60 mm clear for 1 s; candidate grades mass recovery, washer retention, immutable loss and a 3 s released dwell.
comparison.reason: Precision fixture insertion does not test granular flow through apertures.
